name: use-debounce
title: Use Debounce
author: gridcn
description: Grid-free debounce hooks: useDebounce(value, delayMs) returns the debounced value, and useDebouncedInput(value, onCommit, options) drives a text input that shows each keystroke at once and commits when typing pauses, on blur, on Enter, and on unmount, waits for an IME composition, and never lets a late echo overwrite the text being typed.
